recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the published FHIR-I decision and existing examples while removing ambiguity from the source wording; no additional work-group decision is needed for this narrow clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-36716 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking search.html to clarify that a reference search using a non-versioned relative reference such as Patient/example should also match an instance whose searched Reference contains Patient/example/_history/1234.
initial_application: The issue had been applied historically by 56eda89182, after FHIR-36715 added the version-specific reference search parameter syntax in db46f9d2d9. The current source also contains the later FHIR-22103 References and Versions rule from 723edd9268. The examples and behavior were present, but the direct FHIR-36716 conformance sentence was grammatically malformed.
additional_context: The referenced Zulip discussion supports the intended distinction: an unversioned reference search should match references to any version of the same resource, while a version-specific search value should match only the specified version. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-04-11 record the 15-0-0 Persuasive vote. FHIR-22103 provides supporting earlier Provenance/search context for independent-of-version matching.
reconciliation: Changed only source/search.html to make the FHIR-36716 conformance sentence explicit: a non-versioned relative reference search parameter value SHOULD match instances whose searched reference contains a versioned reference to the same target resource.
source_changes: source/search.html: clarified the reference search note for non-versioned relative reference values matching versioned references to the same target resource.

related_jiras.note: Added the version-specific reference search parameter syntax in the same search.html paragraph; it supplies the syntax FHIR-36716 relies on but did not need an additional decision here.
